description: §42.4: a `bool` condition is a boolean test — admitted.
rationale: §42.4 statement 1: "A condition whose value is a `bool` is true when the value is `true`." Provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S460 "a′, go" (supersedes S440 Truthiness Q2 for conditions; keeps S440 #4 = (c), Q1, Gotcha Q2, S442).
